comment: Hi; I hope all of you are doing well today. I hope I'm not being rude; but isn't it your job to look out for all of your residents? In the Old West people protected themselves. But we decided to elect people to pass laws we wanted. Elected officials hire the police chief; who hire the officers; who enforce the laws we the people want. We give cops a badge & gun. We trust that they will enforce the laws correctly; and not act like criminals. We put a lot of trust in them. Normally if someone approaches you with a gun; you assume they intend to kill you. But not when it's a cop. We assume our cops are heroes & to be trusted. Now I give credit. When the autistic child was shot I got to see it all. Early on I read how one cop confronted the shooter; unbelieving they'd shot a disabled child. In the video we see a mom thinking she's getting help for her son. She says a lot of stupid things. As a person in a military family full of soldiers; cops; nurses; doctors; EMTs; firemen, I know you must ignore irrational words & stay calm. These officers should have insured someone qualified interfaced with this child. The boy had witnessed his grandfather gunned down by cops. He feared them. Good officers should have reached out to this boy in the past to make sure he knew they were his friends. They did not; leaving him afraid of them. After watching what I did I don't blame him for being afraid. So in the beginning I hear a cop state they are going to shoot the child. That's premeditation. This cop should not be a cop. Who approaches a disabled child assuming they will shoot a child who probably be s unarmed but may own a water gun. In our nation we have ex soldiers; cops; hunters. Yet most are law abiding citizens. If someone called a cop are they supposed to just roll up shooting at citizens because thet are armed? Of course not. This is America. We the people are the government. The second amendment allows us to be armed. So why were these cops running around guns drawn like they were in a Middle East combat zone? Cops are supposed to be heroes. I instead saw cowards running around guns drawn hunting an unarmed disabled child. I wish their had been some real men there that night to help this boy. Instead he got cowards who think it's ok to just hunt & shoot an unarmed disabled child. I rarely watch the news. But the pandemic forced me too. I watched a man chased in trucks then blocked off & confronted by armed men for trespassing. Not even on their property. He's dead. I wondered why did it take protests to get these men arrested? So I watched the protests. Why are so many so angry at their own cops & gov? We all elect the gov. We pay the cops. They are our employees. Our laws hold them responsible same as us. Or does it? I admit I'm almost always on the cops side. I've raised money to buy them vests. I've prayed for & cried when local cops were killed. Gave money for their families. I back the blue. But I can't support this. I keep waiting. When is the cop that shot this child to be sent to prison? If that had been some black dudes hunting down & shooting one of those cops daughters the black guys would be locked up. So why isn't the cop who hunted down this child in jail? I've hunted. I know you never shoot a gun unless you know what your shooting. Driving a car; picking up a weapon. Such things are not taken lightly. Your actions can harm others. I watched the videos. I know I would not have drawn a gun in this instance. I expect cops to have the same common sense. I saw a tiny unarmed boy brightly lit. I instantly saw he was unarmed & no threat. Yet some insane cop shot this baby over & over. I wish the other cops had the courage to step between the poor baby & this insane cop. But no one did. It's a blessing from God that this baby wasn't killed by the nut job cop. But now we the people are waiting. This is our nation. We elect the politicians. We pay them. Provide them insurance. We expect them to serve us. We expect them to hire a good person to be police chief. Them to hire good cops to serve us. We don't expect them to hunt down disabled children. If a random cop goes insane; & tries to kill a child, we expect that cop to goto prison. Yet that's not happening. Why? I now see why the protestors are so angry. They are mad because a cop can choose to just hunt down an unarmed disabled child anytime they want; and they are above the law. That's obviously true. Oh I know nearly every cop is a good person. I?m not going to stop waving at cops and thanking them. My kids will soon be soldiers. One will probably be a cop after that. But I have a problem with a cop being above our laws. I see we the people need to put civilian boards over the police departments. We need to make certain when the rare cop is in fact the danger to society; that they are either fired, or charged. I'll never support the violence I've seen in streets by protestors. But I understand their rage now. They feel unsafe. They feel cops can just kill them anytime they want & they won't be held accountable. I'll admit I never believed that. But I watched this baby shot in your city. God opened my eyes. I waited for the cop to be arrested. I realize that's never going to happen. I read international news. I saw this story all the way in the Middle East. Think on that. There are Muslims in the Middle East who care more about this disabled little boy than the people who run the American city where he lives. That's a powerful realization God made me see. You expect the leaders of this city to insist the cop answer for shooting this child. Yet the shooter is hiding in the shadows like the coward they are. I'm just an old disabled man. Yet I do my part. As a boy I jumped in the ocean & saved a child. I've climbed in wrecked cars. I saved a child. I once fought a man to save the woman he was beating. I was relieved when the cops finally arrived to take over. I'm just an ordinary Christian citizen. I view cops as the heroes. I'd never harm a child. I'd die for one. I've risked my life for children. But I've never harmed one. I'm just an ordinary person like most people in this great land. Yet I've watched cowards hunting a child. I can't do anything about it except expect justice. We elect politicians to ensure we are represented. That would be you. So when is the cop who shot this child to be arrested? I'm a real man. I know what I watched was wrong. An act of evil. No normal person would have pulled a gun & shot that child. So I thought about it. A cop broke. They went temporarily insane. They tried to kill an unarmed child. Yet they get away with it. They are being protected. That's a reflection on America. It means we the people are not responsible. We allow this. This boy will grow up. If he were an adult disabled person who'd been scared by cops in the past. If he ran from them in fear; they may chase & kill him for no reason, & no one would care. That's now obvious to me. That's why these protestors are in the streets. They don't want to be hunted down & killed. As a Christian who loves America; that was hard for me to accept. I gave up waiting on Utah to do the right thing. You don't care about this child. He doesn't matter to you. That means no disabled child in your city matters. Oh if it was a rich or influential persons child they'd matter. But this boy has no dad. No money. His mom isn't overly stable. She heard a cop threaten to kill her child & let them go off guns drawn. What kind of parent wouldn't try to save their child? So this boy is alone in this world. No one in his city cares about him. The people who should are just letting the cop who shot him get away with it. I can't change their hearts. But as a follower of Christ I must care about this child. In college I remember a teacher calling me out. She said you wear a cross. You are the top student in this college. You are very smart. You should step up to speak for those who can't. I didn't get it. I'm a very passive person. But now I do get it. My vote is my voice. I let everyone I know watch this video. A combat vet said the cop was wrong. As did a hunter. As did a cop. They all saw what I a trained person saw. An unarmed child brightly lit up. We all instantly knew we'd never had shot that child. Yet someone did. Why are they getting away with that? This is why the protestors are so angry. They could be at home safe. Instead they are in the streets risking their lives hoping people like me listen to them. I saw where a sweet young lady was ran over in the road. These people are so desperate to be heard they are standing in the road; risking their lives, just to be heard. I thought about something from my college days. I worked in a factory. It was discovered a young man was gay. The other men shunned him. He was very small. Over the months I heard men call him hateful names & threaten him. I was a married Christian. People liked me. But one day I saw some men threaten him with violence. He lowered his head in fear. I was always the alpha male. Very athletic. I stepped between them. They felt powerful. Large men threatening one tiny gay man. But they backed up when a very large alpha male stepped in. I'm not gay; but I learned of their plight. Rumors spread I was gay. My friends stopped sitting with me. I had to start setting with the liberal women at their table. That was so odd. A large Christian conservative forced to set at the table with a bunch of vegan women. They didn't like that I fished & voted Republican, but they accepted me. They even fed me. I was a hero to them. I had protected one of them. I see something about myself I never saw. I'm a better servant of God than most. When we see the least amongst us; and step up for them, we are showing our love of Jesus. He's my perfect brother. He died so I could be forgiven. I give up on your city. I know that cop is going to get away with it. They will hand them a gun again. No child will be safe around that loon. Oh well; the world is a fallen place. But I can change myself. I will now only vote for liberals. Even if they don't like me for being a Christian. They probably don't like that my children will be soldiers. That's OK. They need my vote to make sure they are safe in our society. I can't trust the people I've been voting for to do that. See I don't have to live in fear. Only a fool would try to intimidate me. No man scares me. I'm an alpha. I know God loves me. So I have no fear. But I should have compassion for others. I should treat a scared gay person; a homeless person; a frightened autistic child running from cops trying to kill him as I would Jesus. But as a man of peace I?m not going to march in streets with signs. Instead I'm going to vote differently. Every parent in America should watch that video. Watch a scared little disabled baby being hunted like a dog by armed grown adults. Watch the poor baby stand there brightly lit as a deranged cop shoots them over and over. Read how the cop just gets away with it. That's on us. We allow that. Well I'm glad Biden won. I now realize the liberals act more like Jesus than most Christians do. I think back to that gay dude at my job. I was a large man. Walking around wearing a large cross. Only I finally stepped up for that scared little gay dude. I can't relate to him. Can't understand why he's gay. But I know right from wrong. When I stood up for him the other large men who used to go play sports with me shunned me. Thinking I a married man who read a Bible at work may be gay. My fellow Christian males distanced themselves from me. I found myself eating alone. Then a liberal women picked up my food & took it to their table. I felt very out of place. Wearing my camo & jungle boots. Giant cross. Reading my Bible. Setting at a table with the outcasts. The vegans. Dyed hair. Pierced noses. I didn't fit. Yet I did. They were gentle & kind. Once I got to know them they were nicer than most of the Christians I knew. They accepted me. Well a little autistic boy was shot in your city. It's obvious none of you care. The cop who shot him just gets away with it. I pray to the God who created me that He puts the same fear in the heart of the cop who shot this baby, as the cop put in this disabled child. Maybe that will change the shooter. Teach them to care about others. Save their soul. Heaven isn't full of people who run around shooting unarmed disabled children. So even though the shooter is evil; I pray God changes their dark soul. I hate to see anyone be lost to the devil. I'm going to stop trying to write to your city. I give up on you. You don't care about disabled kids. I can't change you. So instead I?ll change me. I now realize every time I voted conservative I empowered things such as this. My votes are why gay children are harassed. Why they can't get a third bathroom. Why disabled people can be mistreated. Why a poor mom has no insurance for her sick children. Why a disabled child can be hunted like a dog & his shooter not held accountable. My vote has power. I'm no moron. I know I?m just one disabled old person. But I'm going to try to talk to every Christian I know. I've already converted one. We Christians need to start standing up for those who can't. By voting for those who will. If those outcasts in the streets. The black teens. The disabled. The gay. If they look behind them and see a large number of polite law abiding Christians they will know that together we can change the world. I may be foolish, but I believe this is a Godly nation. But we are a work in progress. We must keep getting better. A gay man should be able to work without threats. A disabled child shouldn't be hunted down and shot by cowards. A black man shouldn't be chased by vehicles of armed men in Georgia. It's funny. I prayed to God to change the hearts of the people in Georgia. Like me; they went blue. It's weird to vote that way. But I feel like a better person now. Like Jesus is happy with me. Maybe one day autistic children will be safe in America. Obvi they aren't safe in Salt Lake. But change starts in your own heart. If I change me; at least I know I stood with Jesus. I pray God changes your city. I pray He starts putting people in power who will protect disabled children. God Bless ☺ Sent from my iPhone

I can understand the sense of healing that might be created for the family of the people painted in the murals on 300 West. I do question how this is a good representation for the City? Criminals that were justifiably killed by police now have a mural to help us remember how good the actions of these people were for the community? Let us teach our children that they too can be remembered by committing acts of crime and putting police in a position to kill them. How is this not a politically motivated message that is being stated with these murals? I am not trying to be insensitive, but rather genuinely confused as to why these murals were put up and are now being protected by the city? Is the city stating that remembering criminals is more important than remembering true heroes of the community? Those that give donations, provide service, donate money, or volunteer countless hours helping those in need. Okay, so the city hates police and what they stand for? No? Then why not have a mural for all the fallen police officers around the state that have been murdered by people like these in the murals? The one guy that held his "friend" hostage with a knife back in July, let's ask his "friend" if we should have let his friend kill him so the cop wouldn't have had to shoot and kill. How about the police officers that were put in the position to have to kill these people? What message is the city sending to their police force about how the city supports its officers? I'm sure they feel the love when they drive past a memorial of the criminal they killed only to think "wow the city must value their life more than mine! Good thing I've sworn to protect this city!" The city should not get into the game of catering to the minority to appease a few whiles ignoring how the real message will be received. 2YES! Salt Lake City supports criminals hurt by police, stand with us to support our criminals! The mayor and city council need to take a long hard look at what they are supporting. Better yet mayor, let us pretend one of these criminals broke into your home and accidentally harmed one of your family members. Would you still support the political statement of these murals because it is the right thing to do? Hmmm?
